name: Harry Potter Workshop
description: For the young wizards in your life, this creative workshop offers a magical dive into the world of Harry Potter.
longDescription:
This creative workshop, scheduled for June 26, 2026, offers an immersive exploration of the Harry Potter universe for younger participants. Designed as a family-friendly activity, the event aims to engage children with the imaginative world of witchcraft and wizardry through hands-on activities. The specific organisers and the full scope of the workshop's content will be announced closer to the date.

Attendees can expect an interactive session focused on creative engagement with themes and elements from the popular book series. The workshop is tailored for a younger audience, providing an opportunity for children to participate in activities inspired by the wizarding world. The duration of the workshop will be confirmed upon finalisation of the programme. The venue for the event is currently TBC within Porto.

Ticketing information and details regarding registration will be released at a later date. As the venue is yet to be confirmed, specific transport instructions and accessibility information are not available at this time. The event is categorised as family-friendly.
